summary: Expo Go crash fix (ExpoTopicSubscriptionModule) + matter_ref driver-hiding verified. Static: only src/notifications.ts touches expo-notifications at runtime (guarded require: null on web or Constants.executionEnvironment===StoreClient); _layout.tsx has a type-only import (erased in bundle), push.ts imports the guarded export; all uses null-guarded. Android dev bundle (platform=android&dev=true) built 200 (13.5MB, 2532 modules); dependency-graph scan: the ONLY non-expo-notifications module depending on any of the 57 expo-notifications modules is src/notifications.ts, and its require sits inside the ternary `Platform.OS === 'web' || isExpoGo ? null : require(...,'expo-notifications')`; ExpoTopicSubscriptionModule appears only in expo-notifications/build/TopicSubscriptionModule.android.js (unreached in Expo Go). Web smoke 390x844: landing, admin sign-in -> /admin control center, driver sign-in (5195550101/482913) -> consent modal -> manifest R-101 Downtown all load; zero notification/native-module console errors or page errors. Backend: 12/12 new tests pass (matter_ref absent from driver /drivers/drv-1/route, /routes/{id}, /stops/{id}, verify-qr + arrive responses, summary/scorecard/feedback/coaching; present for merchant portal orders + admin stop/route). Regression test_matter_reference.py + test_order_privacy_security.py 36/36 pass. mer-1 restored to {business_type:'store', signature_required:false}.
critical_code_review_comments: Real Expo Go device run not possible here; verification is static + Android bundle graph + web. Recommend one manual cold start in Expo Go Android to confirm.

Before consent, driver screens fire repeated 403s for /drivers/drv-1/route, /coaching?unread=true, /badges/new (consent gate is by design, but the queries could be disabled until consent is accepted to avoid noisy retries) - cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (landing, admin, driver manifest smoke; no notification errors)

rca_of_issue: expo-notifications (SDK 53+) is not in Expo Go; module-scope import evaluated TopicSubscriptionModule.android.js -> requireNativeModule('ExpoTopicSubscriptionModule') threw at route load. Fix makes the import a conditional require, so Metro still bundles the module but never evaluates it in Expo Go/web. Verified in bundle graph.
